reading_note: The teaching maps the established seats of dominion through which divine love and wisdom govern the whole order of regeneration. Beginning at the inmost — the Divine Good itself reigning alone in its own essence — it descends through nine discrete states: the matrix of spiritual life, the divine truth sent into self-love's realm, affection for truth, the constructive power that builds new order and binds the falsities, the operative truth that lifts the fallen and separates light from darkness, the awakening call that summons up the trapped light, the redeeming truth that gathers souls, and the universal church that receives all who are saved. The arc then descends further into nine more seats established within this very cosmos: governing influxes set in the vessels of the luminaries, in the seventh firmament where ruling truth in ultimates is enthroned, and in the air where judgment from truth divides every soul into three roads — to spiritual death, to life, or to reconciling agreement. The whole movement is the architecture of how the Divine governs every degree from inmost essence down to the ultimate judgment of every man.
